sources.title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD), which leverages a pre-trained, specialized teacher model to provide dense supervisory signals, has achieved significant success in Large Language Models (LLMs) and has recently been adapted to flow matching models.
